card.title: We Always Did This
card.instruction: Treat the strangest behavior in the scene as an old shared tradition that needs no explanation and deserves immediate continuation.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've set the invisible ancestor's chair by the window again. Pass his plate.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's our last chair. Where does my boyfriend sit?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: On the piano stool, like every newcomer. Your father managed.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He brought the pudding. Can't the ancestor share?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. Pudding bearers sit on his lap. Put a cushion down, as usual.

mechanism: A treats the invisible ancestor's seat as a familiar household tradition and fits the newcomer into increasingly specific supposed precedents.
confusable: Unlike merely accepting an invisible guest, A uses old shared practice as the reason not to explain or abandon the arrangement.
comparison: This alternative accommodates a boyfriend through an inherited seating custom; the other maintains backward movement through linked arms.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
